t: Greetings to participants and guests of gala concert of the 17th White Cane International Charity Festival
d: Vladimir Putin sent a message of greetings to the participants and guests of the 17th White Cane International Charity Festival, held in the Year of Unity of the Peoples of Russia.
Vladimir Putin held a videoconference meeting with participants in the 21st forum and congress of the Delovaya Rossiya National Public Organisation.
